behaviour-switch.answer: The switch is DialectBehavior.CompileTimeArithmeticImplementorDefined (src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/Control/DialectBehavior.cs:301), read only by CompileTimeArithmetic.For (src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Frontend/Expressions/CompileTimeArithmetic.cs:44), which picks the mode for operand entry and + - * / inside a compile-time arithmetic expression (§2002:7.2.5.2 GR1; its 34-digit 2002 mode against §2002:8.8.1.3.1.1's 32 digits is the known PB5575-family defect, reaching only results of arithmetic operations). The rule is a category check; an arithmetic expression is of category numeric whatever mode evaluates it (§2002:7.2.10.2 SR11), so the switch cannot change which programs it refuses. Re-run now at --std 2002: n_sr12_alnum_thru.cob and n_sr12_bool_thru.cob refused (COBOL1619), eval_basic.cob THRU-OK, THRU-ARITH-OK (small values, identical in either mode) (E:\COBOL-coord\scratch\op-20261114\read-2002\out-answer\probes-a-03\run-q02-2002.log, E:\COBOL-coord\scratch\op-20261114\read-2002\out-answer\probes-a-03\run-evalbasic-2002.log).
